package.name: v8_grid
package.description: World-coordinate to grid-cell indexing primitives. The single authoritative implementation of the rounding conventions frozen from the seven historical call sites (2026-11-18, plan M1). Python modules live in the source tree and are imported via sys.path (repo convention); this package exists so the dependency direction is enforced by the build system (target_workspace.py fail-fasts on missing v8_* depends).
